# ui::testing::TestMessageBoxHost

Header: `winui/testing/TestMessageBoxHost.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::MessageBoxHost`.

[MessageBoxHost](../tree/message-box-host.md) test double: shows nothing, records every box it was asked for and answers with [`answer`](#answer).

Install it with [set_message_box_host()](namespace-ui-testing.md#set_message_box_host); [ui::message_box()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#message_box) then reaches it. It uninstalls itself when destroyed.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestMessageBoxHost boxes;
ui::testing::set_message_box_host(&boxes);
boxes.answer = ui::MessageBoxResult::No;

const ui::MessageBoxResult result =
    ui::message_box({.text = "Save changes?", .buttons = ui::MessageBoxButtons::YesNo});
REQUIRE(result == ui::MessageBoxResult::No);
REQUIRE(boxes.shown.size() == 1);
REQUIRE(boxes.shown[0].text == "Save changes?");
```

## answer

```cpp
MessageBoxResult answer = MessageBoxResult::Ok
```

What every box answers.

```cpp
std::vector<MessageBoxOptions> shown
```

```cpp

```
